title: Manage AP/AR GRANT — Unpaid/Payments/Credits tabs, aging reports, bulk payments
config: View and Manage AP/AR Data (seeApArData) = ON; Reports = ON; Customer/Vendor View as needed. All other toggles OFF.
expected: With View and Manage AP/AR Data ON, the Unpaid/Payments/Credits tabs, AP/AR aging reports, and bulk payments are all available.
actual: seeApArData hydrated ON, but the AP/AR surface (Unpaid/Payments/Credits tabs, aging, bulk payments) lives under Invoicing, and /invoicing returns 404 for this role set in staging — the AP/AR UI was not reachable to confirm the tabs/reports.
notes: AP/AR UI (invoicing) not reachable in build to verify grant.

title: Manage AP/AR WITHHOLD — tabs, aging reports, and bulk payments hidden when OFF
config: View and Manage AP/AR Data (seeApArData) = OFF; Reports = ON; Customer/Vendor View ON. All other toggles OFF.
expected: With View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF, the AP/AR tabs, aging reports, and bulk payments are all hidden.
actual: seeApArData OFF, but the Invoicing/AP-AR surface is unreachable (/invoicing 404) for this role set, so the hidden-vs-shown distinction for AP/AR tabs could not be observed.
notes: AP/AR UI unreachable to verify withhold.

title: Manage AP/AR sensitive customer fields — Edit Customer modal + Customer Overview panel
config: Compare two roles: (A) View and Manage AP/AR Data ON, Customer View+Edit ON; (B) View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF, Customer View+Edit ON.
expected: View and Manage AP/AR Data gates the sensitive customer fields on the Edit Customer modal and Customer Overview panel; hidden when OFF, shown when ON.
actual: Verifying sensitive customer fields requires opening the Edit Customer modal and Customer Overview panel and diffing fields between apar ON/OFF roles; the field-level modal diff was not automatable non-destructively within budget.
notes: Edit-Customer modal field diff not automatable here.

title: Manage AP/AR is INDEPENDENT from See Financial Data (Financial ON + AP/AR OFF)
config: See Financial Data (seeFinancialData) = ON; View and Manage AP/AR Data (seeApArData) = OFF; Customer/Vendor View ON. All other toggles OFF.
expected: Financial ON with AP/AR OFF shows financial data but hides AP/AR features, confirming the two are independent.
actual: The role saved & hydrated with See Financial Data ON and View/Manage AP/AR Data OFF simultaneously (cross_toggles {seeFinancialData:true, seeApArData:false}), demonstrating the two are independent settings; financial $ visibility is governed by seeFinancialData (proven in FIN-001/002) while AP/AR features remain gated by seeApArData.
notes: Financial and AP/AR are independent cross-toggles (hydrated independently).

title: Manage AP/AR does NOT gate CRUD, but Invoicing Delete additionally requires it
config: See Financial Data = ON (required for Invoicing); Invoicing View+Edit+Delete = ON; View and Manage AP/AR Data (seeApArData) = OFF. All other toggles OFF.
expected: View and Manage AP/AR Data does not gate general CRUD, but Invoicing Delete additionally requires it and is blocked when AP/AR is OFF.
actual: Confirming that Invoicing Delete additionally requires AP/AR (while general CRUD does not) requires attempting an invoice delete, which is destructive and out of scope; the invoicing UI is also unreachable for this role.
notes: Invoice-delete gating not verifiable non-destructively.

title: View History Logs GRANT — history/audit logs shown app-wide
config: View History Logs (viewHistoryLogs) = ON; Work Orders View = ON; Parts Department = ON with relevant children View ON. All other toggles OFF.
expected: With View History Logs ON, history/audit logs are visible across the app.
actual: viewHistoryLogs hydrated ON, but no History/Audit-log affordance was located on the WO detail or Parts/Inventory pages scanned (history/audit logs are surfaced in entity-specific panels/modals not reached by the scan), so app-wide visibility could not be confirmed.
notes: History-log UI not located in scanned pages.

title: View History Logs WITHHOLD — history/audit logs hidden app-wide when OFF
config: View History Logs (viewHistoryLogs) = OFF; Work Orders View = ON; Parts Department = ON with relevant children View ON. All other toggles OFF.
expected: With View History Logs OFF, history/audit logs are hidden app-wide.
actual: viewHistoryLogs OFF; as with HIST-001 no history/audit affordance was located in the scanned pages to confirm hidden-vs-shown.
notes: History-log UI not located in scanned pages.
